prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1150; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received by phone from the insured driver regarding a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. Insured reports stopping at a red light when the vehicle behind made contact at low speed. Police report requested. Vehicle towed from scene to a preferred repair facility for inspection.

Entry 2: Recorded statement taken from the insured. Insured reports no prior accidents this policy term and states the other driver appeared to be looking at a phone at impact. Photos of both vehicles received and attached to file. Liability appears clear on the facts reported, pending police report review.

Entry 3: Notice of representation received from claimant's attorney's office. All future communication to be directed through counsel. Letter of representation acknowledged. Request for medical records, prior treatment history, and wage documentation sent to counsel. Claimant reports a concussion with ongoing headaches and dizziness per the demand package preview.

Entry 4: Medical records received from treating physician and imaging facility. Diagnosis consistent with mild traumatic brain injury. Claimant has been referred to a neurology follow-up. Records show a prior history of migraines, which counsel was asked to clarify. Reserve reviewed and adjusted to reflect the reported injury. Referred to the bodily injury unit for evaluation.

Entry 5: Supervisor review completed. Liability position remains favorable to the insured, but damages cannot be evaluated until treatment is complete. Counsel advised that a settlement demand will be considered once the neurology report is received. Diary set for follow-up in thirty days to check on treatment status and request updated records.
